call_points.text: Order book was ₹1,853 Cr on 1 July 2026, against ₹1,863 Cr at the start of the year.
Air compressor division had its highest-ever quarterly order booking, led by Tezcatlipoca centrifugal machines.
Biogas order booking hit a record for a quarter, though from a small base.
Zephyros capex commitment is ₹320 Cr across FY27 and FY28, plus ₹100 Cr of other FY27 capex.
Two Zephyros packages are installed and a third goes in this month; the first order was received this month.
Precision engineering is expected to be 10-15% of the business in 5-7 years.
The company is debt-free, with no term or working capital loans, and its CRISIL rating was upgraded to AA.
Service income from gas-station O&M is expected to grow 25-30%, not the 50% seen in FY26.
Middle East package orders are deferred and may take quite some time; domestic demand is described as robust.
Some Q1 revenue slipped to Q2, a mix of package and product, and management would not quantify it.
FY27 growth guided at 20% plus on both top line and bottom line, a long-term aspiration.
₹320 Cr PLI capex committed, ~₹60 Cr spent, balance over about two years.
Zephyros air conditioning package to be commercialised in Q1FY27; two units already installed.
Tezcatlipoca centrifugal compressors: 130 machines in the field, 85 commissioned.
New products targeted at 10-15% of sales; company overall growth target 20%.
Middle East disruption makes dispatching existing packages and booking new orders difficult; exports only ~6% of sales.
Debt-free with net cash of about ₹460 Cr as on 1 April 2026.
Board approved subdivision of ₹2 shares into ₹1, subject to shareholder approval.
Precision Engineering division is non-reportable for FY26 but will be reportable from Q1FY27.

operating_notes.text: Opening order board ₹1,863 Cr at 1 April 2026, of which ~₹500 Cr is executable beyond FY27 and the rest in FY27.
Tezcatlipoca centrifugal compressors: 130 machines in the field, 85 commissioned.
Exports about 6% of total sales; O&M business manages over 1,000 CNG stations across India.
Package dispatches were less than 25% of Q1FY27 revenue.
Gas is 35-40% of the business; CGD stations are projected to grow from about 7,000 today to about 15,000 in 2031.
Precision engineering is about 15% of the order book and is to be executed within a year.

timeline.summary: On 27 April 2026 Kirloskar Pneumatic's Q4FY26 call guided FY27 growth of 20%+ and a sustainable 18-20% EBITDA margin, against an opening order board of ₹1,863 Cr.
On 22 July 2026 Kirloskar Pneumatic's Q1FY27 call kept FY27 revenue guidance at ₹2,100 Cr and the 18-20% EBITDA band, reported an order book of ₹1,853 Cr on 1 July 2026 and a CRISIL upgrade to AA.
